requestBody: Geli cinwaanka iimaylka aad u isticmaasho Vaultara. Waxaan kuu soo diri doonnaa link aad ku xaqiijiso. Waxba lama tirtirayo ilaa aad xaqiijiso.
emailInvalid: Geli cinwaan iimayl oo sax ah.
sentBody: Haddii akoon Vaultara ah uu isticmaalo cinwaankan, waxaan u dirnay link xaqiijin ah. Link-gu wuxuu dhacayaa 1 saac kadib. Haddii aysan waxba iman, hubi galka spam-ka.
reviewIntro: Tirtirka akoonkaagu si joogto ah ayuu u saarayaa:
item2: Sawirradaada, lifaaqyadaada iyo dukumentiyadaada la keydiyay
item4: Link-yadaada wadaagga, link-yada kalandarka iyo xubinnimadaada guriga
subscriptionNote: Tirtirka akoonkaagu ma joojinayo isdiiwaangelinta. Ka jooji Google Play ama App Store si aan lacag lagaaga jarin mar kale.
confirmCheck: Waan fahamsanahay in tan aan dib loo celin karin.
confirmRequired: Calaamadee sanduuqa si aad u xaqiijiso.
doneBody: Akoonkaaga Vaultara iyo xogtiisa waa la tirtiray. Waad xidhi kartaa boggan.
donePendingBody: Waxaan bilownay tirtirka akoonkaaga. Waxay qaadan kartaa dhowr saacadood in la dhammeeyo. Waad xidhi kartaa boggan.
failed: Wax baa khaldamay. Hubi isku xirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.
rateLimited: Isku day aad u badan. Wax yar sug oo isku day mar kale.
expiredBody: Link-yadu waxay shaqeeyaan 1 saac. Mar kale geli iimaylkaaga si aad u hesho mid cusub.
usedBody: Akoonkan waxaa laga yaabaa in horay loo tirtiray. Haddii aad weli akoon leedahay, codso link cusub.
invalidBody: Link-gu waxaa laga yaabaa inuu dhammaystirnayn. Mar kale ka fur iimaylka ama codso mid cusub.
step1: Hoos ku geli cinwaanka iimaylka aad u isticmaasho Vaultara.
step2: Fur link-ga aan u dirno cinwaankaas.
step3: Hubi faahfaahinta oo xaqiiji. Kadib akoonkaaga waa la tirtirayaa.
inApp: Waxaad sidoo kale akoonkaaga ka tirtiri kartaa app-ka Vaultara: Bogga shakhsiga, kadib Amniga iyo asturnaanta, kadib Tirtir koontada.
keptBody: Wax kale laguma hayo Vaultara. Nuqullo ayaa ku hari kara kaydka gurmadka ee Google Cloud dhowr toddobaad ilaa xog kale laga dul qoro. Diiwaanada sharcigu nooga baahan yahay inaan hayno, sida diiwaanada canshuurta, waxaa la hayaa oo keliya inta sharcigu u baahan yahay. Google Play iyo Apple waxay hayaan diiwaanadooda u gaarka ah ee iibsashooyinkaaga.
